purpose: Identify the NCBI RefSeq annotation release closest to the Bhandari extraction by counting exact accession.version matches. Source metadata only; no model result was used.
method: Top-level RNA features (ID=rna-*) of each release GFF, transcript_id compared with the accession.version in every Bhandari header. Files downloaded to a scratch directory, MD5 checked against each release's md5checksums.txt; not part of an acquisition manifest except the releases later acquired by reference_acquisition_v2 and v3.
not_scanned: Human releases on other assemblies (105, 110, RS_2023 onward); mouse release 109 and later (GRCm39). No GRCm38 release older than 108 is listed on the NCBI FTP.
